item.title: US states sue Trump administration over new tariffs on 60 trading partners
item.summary: Coalition of 25 states asks US Court of International Trade to halt tariffs and declare them them unlawful Trump imposes fresh tariffs on dozens of trading partners A coalition of 25 US states sued the Trump administration on Monday over new tariffs pegged at 10% to 12.5% on goods from 60 trading partners, calling them a pretext for replacing import taxes struck down by the supreme court in February. The states are asking the US Court of International Trade to halt the tariffs, declare them unlawful and order refunds of duties that have already been paid. Continue reading...
